punchline: In Ruiz's example, one sentence said through a headache was enough to make a girl afraid of her own voice.
thirty_sec: Don Miguel Ruiz describes a mother who comes home with a headache. Her daughter is singing happily, and the mother tells her to shut up because her voice is ugly. The girl grows afraid to use her voice and may turn shy and withdrawn. Ruiz calls it black magic and says we do it to people we love without noticing. That is why his first agreement asks you to be impeccable with your word.
